note: Trigger-accuracy regression suite. Same shape and run command as ../../recording-decisions/evals/README.md.

evals.name: can-this-automerge
evals.prompt: this branch only touches generated protocol types and a lockfile. can it go in without a human looking at it, or does someone have to review it?
evals.why: The route question asked in plain words.

evals.name: why-escalated
evals.prompt: CI escalated PR 412 to human review and I don't understand why — everything on the branch is green and the kb records all look fine. which rule fired?
evals.why: Asking which row of the route table matched.

evals.name: ci-gate-step
evals.prompt: add a step to our merge workflow that fails the job unless the branch is either mechanical or has an approval from someone in the owners list.
evals.why: The --enforce contract is exactly this.

evals.name: who-reviews
evals.prompt: who needs to look at main..HEAD before it merges — nobody, the reviewer agent, or a person? the base has risks and a couple of open questions in it.
evals.why: The three routes, named.

evals.name: materiality-floor
evals.prompt: we want anything tagged review:security to count as important even when the author marked it non-blocking, and to block automerge until someone other than the author has verified it. where does that live?
evals.why: Floors and the unverified-important row.

evals.name: merge-policy-file
evals.prompt: what goes in .strauss/merge-policy.yaml, and does a change to it on my own branch take effect for that branch's own check?
evals.why: The policy schema and the base-rev read.

evals.name: approval-source
evals.prompt: dana ran kb verify on the decision under her human: actor. does that count as her approving the merge?
evals.why: The hardening rule: approval comes from the reviews API, never from a verify event.

evals.name: deleted-record-route
evals.prompt: someone deleted a risk record on this branch and there's no supersede behind it. should the merge check still let this through automatically?
evals.why: The record-deleted row.

evals.name: auto-vs-agent-review
evals.prompt: when does the pipeline pick agent-review-then-auto instead of straight auto for a pull request?
evals.why: Two of the three route values, by name.

evals.name: excluded-path
evals.prompt: our policy excludes packages/legacy-reporting, but this diff there now imports a type out of src/checkout. does the exclusion still hold for the merge decision?
evals.why: The crossing check inside the route step.

evals.name: write-the-record
evals.prompt: i just changed how the retry budget is scoped. write the decision record for it with the anchors and the rejected alternative.
evals.why: Writing a record is recording-decisions.

evals.name: reading-order
evals.prompt: give me an html page that walks a reviewer through this PR in a sensible order, blocking risks first.
evals.why: The reading deck is review-walkthrough.

evals.name: run-the-reviewer
evals.prompt: spawn the kb reviewer on this branch and show me its verdicts per record.
evals.why: Collecting and running the reviewer is kb-review.

evals.name: gate-blocked-me
evals.prompt: the stop hook keeps blocking my turn saying A1 — a changed symbol with no record. what do i write to get past it?
evals.why: Fixing a gate block is review-companion's loop, not the route.

evals.name: branch-protection
evals.prompt: set up github branch protection on main: two required approvals, dismiss stale reviews, require the build check.
evals.why: GitHub repository settings, not a route computed from a base.

evals.name: merge-conflict
evals.prompt: i have a merge conflict in pnpm-lock.yaml after rebasing onto main. how do i resolve it?
evals.why: A git conflict; "merge" is the only word in common.

evals.name: kb-query
evals.prompt: has anyone already decided how repositories retry transient store errors? i don't want to decide it twice.
evals.why: A base lookup, answered by knowledge-base.

evals.name: code-review-content
evals.prompt: review this diff and tell me what's wrong with it — correctness bugs, not process.
evals.why: A code review, not a decision about who performs one.

evals.name: release-plan
evals.prompt: write the nx release version plan for this change and pick the bump.
evals.why: Release mechanics; nothing to do with review routing.

evals.name: classify-files
evals.prompt: which files in this diff are generated and which are hand-written? just the classification.
evals.why: The classifier verb on its own; the route is the consumer, not the answer.
